description: Replace the entire token layer. Rewrite tailwind.config.js and src/styles/globals.css to implement the Charcoal+Orange dark / White+Orange light design system. This is the foundation — FEAT-002 depends on these tokens being available.
acceptance_criteria: tailwind.config.js contains accent, base, surface, success, warning, error, info colour scales and card-* boxShadow tokens — does NOT contain lavender, pink, blush, babyblue, mint, peach, or glass.* entries
globals.css :root defines all --color-* custom properties for light mode; .dark overrides them for dark mode; no lavender/purple hex values remain
globals.css .card uses solid background (var(--color-surface)) with a 1px border and a single box-shadow — no backdrop-blur, no rgba transparency on the background
globals.css .btn-primary is bg-accent-500 with white text — no lavender
globals.css .nav-item-active has orange left-border indicator — no glass-lavender background fill
index.html has an inline script that adds 'dark' class before any render
ThemeContext default is 'dark' for first-time visitors (localStorage empty)
`npx tsc --noEmit` passes with zero errors after applying FEAT-001 alone (components may still reference old token names that no longer exist — FEAT-002 fixes components)
findings: TOKEN NAMES FOR FEAT-002: Tailwind colour scales available: accent-{50..950}, base-{0,50..950}, surface-{light,light-elevated,light-secondary,dark,dark-card,dark-elevated,dark-sidebar,dark-input}, success-{50,100,400,500,600,900}, warning-{50,100,400,500,600,900}, error-{50,100,400,500,600,900}, info-{50,100,400,500,600,900}, ink-{50..950}. Box-shadow tokens: shadow-card-light, shadow-card-dark, shadow-card-hover-light, shadow-card-hover-dark, shadow-accent. CSS custom properties: --color-bg, --color-bg-secondary, --color-surface, --color-surface-elevated, --color-sidebar, --color-input-bg, --color-text-primary, --color-text-secondary, --color-border, --color-border-hover, --color-accent, --color-accent-hover, --color-accent-ring. Component classes: surface, surface-elevated, card, card-hover, card-interactive, btn-primary, btn-secondary, btn-ghost, btn-danger, nav-item, nav-item-active, badge-*, status-*, job-*, table-container, modal-overlay, modal-content, spinner-*. Legacy aliases that now redirect to new tokens: card-lavender/pink/blush/blue/mint/peach all map to .card; badge-lavender maps to badge-primary; badge-mint/peach/pink/blue/babyblue map to semantic equivalents; avatar-lavender/blue/mint/pink/blush map to accent-coloured avatar. glass/glass-strong/glass-subtle removed — use surface or surface-elevated instead. bg-bg-light and bg-bg-dark removed — use bg-[var(--color-bg)] or surface classes.
